policy.rule: Lower-priority sources may fill unknowns or constrain probabilities but may not overwrite higher-priority observations.
policy.licensing: Use public APIs/services and metadata lawfully. Respect dataset-specific access, attribution, non-redistribution and license requirements. Do not scrape restricted datasets.
